description: Structured output every persona emits during adversarial deliberation rounds (v1.19).

grounding.ref: string — e.g. task_map[0], PRD line, header/CTA, --color-primary

persona_output_block.satisfaction_with_prior: number 0.0–1.0 — how satisfied with prior persona output
persona_output_block.accepts_prior: boolean — true only if satisfaction >= threshold
questions: string — contextual questions about UI, PRD, task, JTBD
revisions: string — concrete changes required in prior output
persona_output_block.synthesis: string — optional; full produce-mode output on final round only
